using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Migrations;

namespace NativeEfAnalyzer;

/// <summary>Retains an intentionally invalid authored call inside a real migration override.</summary>
public sealed class AuthoredMigrationControl : Migration
{
    /// <inheritdoc />
    protected override void Up(MigrationBuilder migrationBuilder)
    {
        migrationBuilder.Sql(GetSql());
    }

    /// <inheritdoc />
    protected override void Down(MigrationBuilder migrationBuilder)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>Supplies authored SQL that must be prepared before the native call.</summary>
    private static string GetSql() => "SELECT 1";
}
